commands.name: generate-skybox
commands.description:
Generate Skybox
Used for generating skyboxes, skybox remixes and depth maps.

options.name: --prompt
options.description: Text prompt describing the skybox world you wish to create. Maximum number of characters: 550. If you are using skybox_style_id then the maximum number of characters is defined in the max-char response parameter defined for each style.

options.name: --negative-text
options.description: Describe things to avoid in the skybox world you wish to create. Maximum number of characters: 200. If you are using skybox_style_id then the maximum number of characters is defined in the negative-text-max-char response parameter defined for each style.

options.name: --enhance-prompt
options.description: Have an AI automatically improve your prompt to generate pro-level results every time (default: false) Specify true/false; presence alone implies true; omit to inherit.

options.name: --seed
options.description: Send 0 for a random seed generation. Any other number (1-2147483647) set will be used to "freeze" the image generator and create similar images when run again with the same seed and settings.

options.name: --skybox-style-id
options.description: Predefined styles that influence the overall aesthetic of your skybox generation (Fantasy landscape, Anime art style, etc...).

options.name: --remix-imagine-id
options.description: ID of a previously generated skybox

options.name: --control-image
options.description: Control image used to influence the generation. The image needs to be exacly 1024 pixels wide and 512 pixels tall PNG equirectangular projection image of a scribble with black (#00000) background and white (#ffffff) brush strokes. For "scribble" effect you will also need to send control_model="scribble".

options.name: --control-imagename
options.description: Control image used to influence the generation. The image needs to be exacly 1024 pixels wide and 512 pixels tall PNG equirectangular projection image of a scribble with black (#00000) background and white (#ffffff) brush strokes. For "scribble" effect you will also need to send control_model="scribble".

options.name: --control-model
options.description: Model used for the control_image. Currently, the only option is: "scribble".

options.name: --init-image
options.description: Image (Binary/Base64 string/Absolute URL) to be used as initial image for Skybox generation. Please use equirectangular 360° images. 2:1 aspect ratio recommended. Maximum file size is 50 megabytes.

options.name: --init-imagename
options.description: Image (Binary/Base64 string/Absolute URL) to be used as initial image for Skybox generation. Please use equirectangular 360° images. 2:1 aspect ratio recommended. Maximum file size is 50 megabytes.

options.name: --init-strength
options.description: Scale to be used as initial influence of the "Init Image" for Skybox generation. The default value is 0, allowed range is between 0 and 0.97, where 0 represents no influence and 0.97 represents lots of influence. Only has an effect when using an init_image parameter.

options.name: --return-depth-hq
options.description: Request for high quality depth map. It will be returned in the depth_map_url parameter. (default: false) Specify true/false; presence alone implies true; omit to inherit.
